# iCommunity

> iCommunity develops and operates independent regulatory trust infrastructure for verifiable evidence, audit compliance and digital product passports in regulated environments. Built on distributed ledger technology, our platform enables organizations to prove integrity from the origin.

## Pages

- [Homepage](/): Independent regulatory trust infrastructure — how it works, use cases, success stories and ecosystem overview.
- [Solutions](/soluciones): Product suite built on iCommunity infrastructure — CertyPass (Digital Product Passport / ESPR), Privaro (AI compliance gateway) and MusicDibs (digital rights verification).
- [Partners](/partners): Partner ecosystem, collaboration models and types of partners (SaaS platforms, certification bodies, technology integrators, public administrations, European projects).
- [Company](/empresa): About iCommunity — mission, principles, commitment to European standards and contact form.
- [Legal Notice](/legal): Privacy policy, legal notice and cookie policy of iCommunity Labs & Tech S.L.
- [Terms of Service](/terminos): Service conditions based on EU regulation (Directive 2011/83/EU, GDPR, DSA).
- [Refund Policy](/reembolsos): Refund and withdrawal policy compliant with EU consumer law.
- [Resources](/recursos): Practical guides on blockchain use cases, payment tokenization and real estate tokenization.
- [Blockchain use cases for business](/recursos/casos-de-uso-blockchain): Practical guide — traceability, payment tokenization, IP & royalties, real estate, public sector.
- [Blockchain payment tokenization](/recursos/tokenizacion-de-pagos): How payment tokenization works on blockchain, benefits and MiCA compliance.
- [Real estate tokenization](/recursos/tokenizacion-inmobiliaria): How to tokenize a real estate asset — process, benefits, MiCA and Spanish regulation.
- [Digital Product Passport (DPP) guide](/recursos/pasaporte-digital-de-producto-dpp): EU ESPR regulation — affected products, timeline, required data and how to implement the DPP with verifiable evidence.
- [Implementing the DPP](/recursos/desafios-implementacion-dpp): Supplier data, interoperability, long-term integrity, costs and access control.
- [Environmental impact of the DPP](/recursos/impacto-ambiental-dpp): Recycling, repair, unsold-goods destruction ban and verifiable environmental claims.
- [Verifactu and blockchain](/recursos/verifactu-blockchain): Spanish AEAT Verifactu requirements, 2027 timeline and adding verifiable evidence to invoicing records.
- [Funded Projects](/financiacion): European and nationally funded projects — PRTR 2025, DATIA, Cervera, NEOTEC and youth employment programs.

## Solutions

- **CertyPass** — Digital Product Passport based on verifiable evidence, compliant with European ESPR regulation.
- **Privaro** — Compliance and data anonymization gateway for regulated AI systems.
- **MusicDibs** — Digital rights and copyright verification platform for the music industry.
